name: Sun Desert

eraModifiers.text: Wilder weather: flash-flood repairs cost 3 materials, and a dust storm can bury 3 exposed buildings.
Hotter summers: homes need 1 more cooling on summer days.

flood.name: Flash flood
flood.summary: the river runs high and floods the wadi banks; farms there gain silt
flood.description: Spring rain in the hills: the river runs high and floods the wadi banks beside it. Farms there gain silt (+50% food in summer and autumn), cisterns there fill, and buildings there that aren’t flood-tolerant are disabled for the season and cost 2 materials to repair.

heatwave.name: Heatwave
heatwave.summary: the river runs dry; homes need more cooling; panels make less by day
heatwave.description: The river runs dry. Every home needs 1 more cooling by day, solar canopies make 1 less by day (too hot to work well), and channels lose twice as much to the sun.

storm.name: Dust storm
storm.summary: dust dims the panels and mirrors; two exposed buildings may be buried
storm.description: Dust on the wind: solar canopies and mirrors make 1 less in each slot, and two exposed buildings (on the reg or the erg) are buried for the season unless a palm windbreak or a palm grove beside them shelters them.

freeze.name: Cold nights
freeze.summary: mild days, cold nights; homes need heat at night
freeze.description: Mild days and cold nights: homes need heat at night (mud-brick walls keep the day’s warmth), and fog nets catch twice as much.

combos.name: Busy Bees
combos.text: An apiary next to oasis gardens or wadi farms: +1 food on each of up to 3, spring to autumn. A wind spire next door scares the bees off.
combos.hint: Bees work the fields around them.

combos.name: Quiet Spire
combos.text: A pollinator meadow next to a wind spire cancels the spire's Harmony penalty.
combos.hint: Flowers soften the hum of the wind spires.

combos.name: Green Doorstep
combos.text: A mud-brick house next to meadow or woodland: +1 wellbeing each season.
combos.hint: People like to live near green land.

combos.name: Kitchen Loop
combos.text: Farm → scraps and biomass → composter → compost → farm. Once it runs, every building in the loop makes +1 (farms food, the composter compost) for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: Put a composter among working farms.

combos.name: Gas Loop
combos.text: Farm biomass → digester → night power, digestate back to the farms. Once it runs, every building in the loop makes +1 (farms food, the digester compost) for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: A digester feeding the night, among working farms.

combos.name: Bath Loop
combos.text: Heat well or sand battery → heat → bathhouse → grey water → reed bed, in a chain of neighbours. It closes when the bathhouse takes its heat from the well or battery next to it and the reed bed next to it cleans grey water. Once it runs, the reed bed makes +1 biomass for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: Warm the bath with a neighbour's spare heat; let reeds clean what it lets out.

combos.name: Heat Cascade
combos.text: Heat runs from hot to warm, losing some at each step: a heat well or sand battery warms the bathhouse next to it, and the bathhouse's warm water heats the greenhouse next to it (up to 1 heat a slot). It closes the first winter the greenhouse is warmed that way. Once it runs, the greenhouse makes +1 food for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: Spare heat from a hot neighbour can warm two buildings, not one.

combos.name: Mushroom Loop
combos.text: Farm → biomass → mushroom cellar → spent substrate (compost) → farm. It closes when a working cellar stands next to a working farm. Once it runs, both make +1 food for as long as it stands.
combos.hint: What a farm leaves, mushrooms eat; what mushrooms leave, a farm eats.

combos.name: Village Green
combos.text: A Commons Plaza ringed by 6 buildings of at least 3 kinds: +2 wellbeing each season.
combos.hint: A gathering place, surrounded on every side by a varied neighbourhood.

combos.name: Wildway
combos.text: An unbroken strip of meadow and woodland from the river to the valley's edge: +10 Harmony, and animals return.
combos.hint: A green corridor from the water to the hills.

combos.name: Treehouse Commons
combos.text: A mud-brick house next to 2 woodland tiles becomes a Treehouse Commons: +2 wellbeing each season instead of +1.

combos.name: Old World Archive
combos.text: A salvage yard whose ruin is empty, next to a Seedbank Library, may become an Old World Archive instead of a Rewilded Ruin: +2 knowledge each season, with 1 worker. You choose.
combos.hint: Not everything worth keeping in a ruin is metal.

tunings.name: Mirror Film
tunings.text: Solar canopies make +1 energy in winter.

tunings.name: Night Shift
tunings.text: Workshops get a 3rd run, on night energy only.

tunings.name: Brighter Panels
tunings.text: Solar canopies make +1 day energy in spring and summer.

tunings.name: Balanced Blades
tunings.text: Wind spires make +1 energy by day and night in summer.

tunings.name: Lean Workshops
tunings.text: Each workshop run needs 1 energy instead of 2.

tunings.name: Hot Compost
tunings.text: A full composter makes 3 compost instead of 2.

tunings.name: Reading Rooms
tunings.text: Seedbank libraries make +1 knowledge every season.

tunings.name: Busy Bees
tunings.text: Each apiary helps 1 more neighbouring farm or orchard.

tunings.name: Festival Nights
tunings.text: A powered Commons Plaza gives +1 more wellbeing.

charters.name: Repair Culture
charters.text: Salvage ×2: each salvage yard makes 6 a season from the same ruin. Workshops turn 2 clutter into 2 materials.

charters.name: Night Market
charters.text: +2 wellbeing each season the night slot is fully powered.

charters.name: Rewilders
charters.text: Tree nurseries improve a neighbouring tile 2 steps a season; pollinator meadows give +1 more Harmony.

visions.name: Green the Desert
visions.text: Make 40% of the desert's healable land meadow or woodland.

visions.name: Lantern of the Desert
visions.text: Go a full year, spring to winter, with 30 or more citizens and no shortfall in any slot.

visions.name: Thriving Commons
visions.text: Reach 50 citizens with wellbeing 70 or more.

projects.name: Green Ground
projects.text: Compost worked into the worst ground: when finished, the 8 least healthy tiles of land each improve one step.

projects.name: Biochar Beds
projects.text: Biomass buried as charcoal feeds the soil for good: +6 Harmony from then on.

projects.name: Seed Vault
projects.text: The desert's seeds, catalogued and kept: +25 to the run's score.

projects.name: Festival Grounds
projects.text: A meadow stage for the turning seasons: +2 wellbeing every season from then on.

projects.name: The Long Shade
projects.text: A shaded walk of palms across the whole desert: +40 to the run’s score.

projects.name: Hanging Gardens
projects.text: Gardens climbing the old array’s frames: +12 Harmony and +1 wellbeing every season from then on.

projects.name: Gift to Root City
projects.text: Seed stock, tools and stories sent ahead: +6 Seeds when the run is sent home.

twists.name: Fair Weather
twists.text: No twist: the seasons as usual.

twists.name: Steady Winds
twists.text: Wind spires make 1 more energy by day and night, but storms can damage 2 exposed buildings.

twists.name: Lean Start
twists.text: The Sprout sets out with 5 materials, 4 food and 4 citizens. The Graft is one tier higher.

twists.name: Big Families
twists.text: Citizens arrive two at a time, but only when a season's harvest leaves 4 food spare after eating (usually 2).

twists.name: Scavengers' Desert
twists.text: The old array hold 12 more salvage each (42 instead of 30), but every clutter costs 2 Harmony.

regions.name: The Oasis
regions.text: The desert as it is: a thin river down one side, an oasis near the middle, gravel plain around, dunes along the far side, rock at the edges, a salt flat and the ruins of an old solar array.

eraGoals.text: Go a full year, spring to winter, with no energy shortfall.

levels.name: Scorching Days
levels.text: Homes need 1 more cooling on summer days.

levels.name: Quick Clutter
levels.text: Citizens make scraps faster: one for every 2 citizens instead of 3.

levels.name: Slow Healing
levels.text: Spreading compost takes 4 compost per step of healing instead of 2.

levels.name: Restless People
levels.text: The population grows only at wellbeing 70 or more, instead of 60.

levels.name: Hot Autumns
levels.text: Homes need 1 more cooling on autumn days.

levels.name: Rough Seasons
levels.text: Flood repairs cost 2 more materials, and storms can damage one more exposed building.

levels.name: Weary People
levels.text: Meeting every need no longer lifts wellbeing.

levels.name: High Hopes
levels.text: Civic life serves 10 fewer citizens before expectations cost wellbeing.

intro: New: the Sun Desert. Bright and dry: the thin river runs high in the spring flash flood and dries up in summer, and the oasis spring refills every season. On hot days homes need cooling: wind towers and shade give it free, absorption chillers make it from spare heat, and the grid pays 2 energy for each. Channels lose water to the sun in every season but winter; a qanat loses none. Sun by day, little by night: store the day for the night.
